note: level-flight trims along AUTO NAC's schedule, [weight][density altitude][KCAS]: the power required (both engines, hp), the collective (deg), the longitudinal stick (-1..1, + forward), the pitch attitude (deg), the trim's residual; the gear up and down; the design CG. Where no trim converged (residual over 0.05): between converged ones along the airspeed the line between them; below the slowest, the power available, standard day, and its trim's. Along KCAS at the design weight and CG, sea level: m_lon_ftlb_in and l_lat_ftlb_in, the stick's pitching and rolling moments, ft lb per inch (+ nose up, right wing down); a_coll_fps2_deg and a_pitch_fps2_deg, the collective's acceleration along the rotors' thrust and the pitch attitude's across it, ft/s^2 per deg (trimmap.py --start)
